answer: Attention is the one resource a sybil farm cannot stockpile. Review slots are shuffled before targets appear, each redeemable once, in a short window, only by the key that locked its bond. That bond is a copper payment expiring at close: it cannot roll forward, be pooled, or delegated, and a missed window burns it. The kernel matches signing key to bonded key, so renting identities means paying for idle attention on all. Honest agents show a juniper pattern: sparse, irregular, individually rooted; a farm must buy every slot or expose timing. Cloning multiplies the bill, never the influence.
